help:
usage: gnd recovery [-h] {inventory,verify} ...

Run the one-time, execution-free recovery boundary. Inventory reads only
explicit categorized roots under ROOT with closed byte/file limits and writes
one immutable JSON census. Verify re-resolves the canonical model, full
verbalization, report, evidence digests, typed locators, and exact selected-
path census. Neither command imports or executes repository code, launches an
agent, invokes conformance, or generates code. Exits 3 for an ill-formed
inventory/report or failed digest/locator claim, 66 when a required input is
missing, and 74 for refused or unreadable paths and I/O.

positional arguments:
  {inventory,verify}
    inventory         write one bounded closed census of explicit static
                      repository roots
    verify            verify the canonical three-artifact recovery bundle and
                      every claim

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
